journey.title: A new week
journey.purpose: Carry forward accepted anchors, preferences, credible stock, and feedback into a preview that explains meaningful changes, preserves locks, and refuses a stale input revision.

steps.intent: Carry forward accepted anchors, current preferences, and credible stock into the next date range.
Preview changed, unchanged, and locked rows and the unknown cost, nutrient, or time contributions.
See that a material input changed and require a rebuilt preview before applying.
Apply the preview against its captured input revision and confirm the week reflects it.

claims.statement: Locked commitments survive replanning and are shown unchanged in the preview.
A scheduled draft is prepared without silently replacing a plan the person already arranged.
